questions.stem: A 22-year-old male presents to the emergency department with a painful, swollen left ear following a physical altercation. On examination, the left auricle is markedly swollen and deformed with a fluctuant, non-erythematous area occupying most of the antihelical fold. There is no laceration or discharge, and the patient denies any hearing loss. Which of the following is the most appropriate management of this condition?
questions.stemHtml: A 22-year-old male presents to the emergency department with a painful, swollen left ear following a physical altercation. There is no laceration or discharge, and the patient denies any hearing loss. Which of the following is the most appropriate management of this condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Incision and drainage followed by pressure dressing

options.label: D
